The '''Royal City''' was a [[city]] located<ref name="SW TVE" /> on a [[mountain]] peak<ref name="Alien Archive">''[[Star Wars: Alien Archive]]''</ref> on the [[planet]] [[Toydaria]].<ref name="SW TVE" /> During the [[Imperial Era]], a [[Gladiator-class Star Destroyer|''Gladiator''-class Star Destroyer]] attacked the Royal City by firing a salvo of [[turbolaser]]s, with the Royal City deploying a [[deflector shield]] in its defense.<ref name="Turbolaser Salvo">{{SWU|set=Jump to Lightspeed|cardname=Turbolaser Salvo|link=8174214418}}</ref> The [[Toydarian Royal Palace]] was located within the Royal City.<ref name="Supply Lines" />
